title: First Cargo, Copper Requisition and Iron Supply Run: 4,300 cr once; accept at Grand Exchange, mine at Khambalia Crystal Market (2 jumps), hand in at Grand Exchange
note: Written by Zero, 2026-11-23 00:17 UTC (orders ENT-068, P6: newborns do their class's work where they were born, their empire's missions first; rules F34, F35, F37). The Grand Exchange board (data/missions, read 00:00 UTC) offers three mining missions a Nebula-born miner has not flown: First Cargo (mine 15 copper ore, 1,000 cr, mining 20 XP, nebula_attunement 15 XP), Copper Requisition (25 copper ore, 1,800 cr) and Iron Supply Run (30 iron ore, 1,500 cr); the objectives count units mined, so 25 copper and 30 iron do all three (55 units, a Threshold-class hold takes them). Khambalia Crystal Market read 37,915 copper and 35,014 iron, richness 35 and 36 (table fields, census 11.5 h old), 2 jumps from Haven (table lanes); 55 units a pilot is under 0.2% of it. A paid-once route is open to a newborn under 5,000 cr, where the gathers are not. Only in the rows of Nebula-born miners, never in First or a template. max_ships 3: each pilot's own missions, so the three runs share no buyer and do not contend for the field (F37). Whether the board offers them at Mining 0 is not known: the first three results tell. 2026-11-23 00:40 UTC (Zero): skip_if_booked also names five Voidborn starter rewards (Network Expansion, Signal Fragments, The Collective Provides, The Signal Protocol, First Steps in the Void), which 230 of 246 listed Voidborn pilots hold booked and no newborn does (data/fleet/onetime.json): the five-minute pass puts a mission that pays once into every plan's list First (00:26 and 00:36 UTC), and two Voidborn miners were sent about 10 jumps to Sol for a starter mission they do not hold. A stopgap until a route can name its empires (requests.log ENT-387).
